Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the birth year of Stewart Raffill. In Step 9, the WebSurfer retrieved the Wikipedia page for Stewart Raffill, and the metadata explicitly stated he was "born 1942". However, in Step 10, the Planner claimed that the WebSurfer retrieved that Raffill was "born 1932". This is a hallucination or misreading of the retrieved data. Consequently, the Planner compared 1932 (incorrectly attributed to Raffill) with 1939 (Blier) and concluded that Raffill was born earlier, leading to the wrong final answer (Lost In Africa) instead of the correct answer (Buffet Froid).
